Package com.acxiom.emailaudit.rules

Class AccessibilityRule

java.lang.Object
com.acxiom.emailaudit.rules.AccessibilityRule
All Implemented Interfaces:
AuditRule
public final class AccessibilityRule extends Object implements AuditRule
AuditRule implementation that runs an axe-core accessibility scan against the rendered page and maps every violation to a RuleResult finding.

axe-core integration

Uses AxeBuilder from com.deque.html.axe-core:playwright (declared in pom.xml). The builder injects the axe-core JS library into the page and returns structured AxeResults without any additional browser configuration.

WCAG targeting

By default the rule runs all axe tags that map to WCAG 2.1 Level A and AA (wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa) plus Deque's best-practice rules (best-practice). This set can be overridden at construction time for narrower or broader scans.

Severity mapping

   axe impact   →  RuleSeverity
   critical     →  CRITICAL
   serious      →  HIGH
   moderate     →  MEDIUM
   minor        →  LOW
   (unknown)    →  INFO

Thread safety

All configurable fields are set once in the constructor and never mutated. A new AxeBuilder is created per execute(Page) call because the builder holds page-scoped state. The class is safe for concurrent use from multiple TestNG threads, each operating on its own Page.
